game-summary.no-matches-desc: Zero matches. Rough. Turns out you're all cinematic snowflakes with wildly different taste — and that's actually great data for us. We just updated your personalization, so the next round is going to hit way differently. One more game?
no-matches-descs: Zero matches. Rough. Turns out you're all cinematic snowflakes with wildly different taste — and that's actually great data for us. We just updated your personalization, so the next round is going to hit way differently. One more game?
And apparently nobody agreed on anything. Classic. On the bright side, we now know exactly what NOT to recommend next time — your personalization just got a serious upgrade. Come back stronger.
Not a single film survived the group vote. Brutal, honestly. But every swipe told us something about your taste, so the next game is already going to be smarter. Don't give up now.

And we mean that as a compliment. Zero overlap in taste means you're all extremely discerning viewers — or just really stubborn. Either way, we've learned from this and your next game will be way better.
We didn't find the right movies to unite the group this time, and that's on us. We've taken notes, updated the algorithm, and promised it a stern talking-to. Next game, we're coming back hotter.
no-picks-descs: You swiped through everything and liked nothing. Bold strategy. Maybe the next round's lineup will finally earn your approval.
Not one movie made the cut for you. Either your standards are sky-high or the algorithm needs a serious talking-to. Probably both.
You let every movie walk right past you. No likes, no picks, no mercy. We're noting this and coming back with a stronger lineup.
Respect the commitment to zero compromise. Not a single film was worthy of your like. We'll do better next time — we have to.
Nothing clicked. That's actually useful data — we now know exactly what leaves you cold. Next round will be a very different story.
